sources.source_name: Fine Homebuilding — Range Hood Ventilation Best Practices
sources.snippet: Vent-A-Hood's centrifugal capture system is fundamentally different from filter-based hoods. The Magic Lung blower spins grease out of the air stream before it reaches the fan, meaning the blower mechanism never accumulates grease. This is architecturally superior to baffle or mesh filter systems where grease passes through the filter and can coat duct runs over time.
sources.classification_reason: Building science expert source confirming centrifugal architecture advantage

bottom_line: Vent-A-Hood PRH is the heritage benchmark in residential range hoods. The Magic Lung centrifugal blower is architecturally unique — no other manufacturer uses this approach. The centrifugal capture system keeps the blower clean indefinitely, which is why these motors last 30+ years. Construction is all 304 stainless, welded seamless, made in Houston TX since 1933. Lifetime motor warranty. Professional consensus places Vent-A-Hood at the top of the residential hood hierarchy. Primary weakness: lower max CFM than external-blower-equipped competitors, and proprietary parts that must go through Vent-A-Hood directly.
